content.rendered:
We are excited to share that Pre-Kindergarten registration is now open for the 2023-24 school year at Hawks View, Middleton and Ridges! Our programs provide high quality early learning opportunities for typically developing children and children with developmental delays and disabilities. There will be 20 slots available at each site, with a balance of incomes and ability levels.

Please see flyer below for more information. To request an application, please contact Amy Gillett at agillett@sherwood.k12.or.us, or call 503-825-5087.
